Disabling linked icon labels keeps accessible names out of visible link text

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"content":{"extract_metadata":false,"include_icon_labels":false},"respect_robots_txt":false}');
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine(config: engineConfig);
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.scrape(engine, url);
    stdout.writeln(result.markdown?.content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
